summary: The backup_file return value gives the path of the backup created by modules supporting backup=yes when the original file changed.
questions: How do I find the path of the backup file created by lineinfile?
What does backup_file contain in a task result?

answer_card.title: backup_file return value
answer_card.answer_md:
With `backup: true`, modules return **`backup_file`**: the path of the backup made when the file changed, e.g. `"./foo.txt.32729.2020-07-30@06:24:19~"`. Use it with `register`:

```yaml
- debug: var=result.backup_file
```
